text:
The change adds day-to-day differences to the summary. The loop runs one iteration too far: for every nonempty input, it accesses `sales[sales.length].cents` and throws, so `summary()` cannot return a report.

Confirmed with one-day and two-day inputs; empty input succeeds. The checkout contains no tests covering these cases.
